item.title: Forget a Mentor, Find a Sponsor: The New Way to Fast-Track Your Career
item.description:
Forget a Mentor, Find a Sponsor: The New Way to Fast-Track Your Career

Summary

“Forget a Mentor, Find a Sponsor: The New Way to Fast-Track Your Career” by Sylvia Ann Hewlett emphasizes the importance of securing a sponsor to accelerate one’s professional journey. Unlike mentors who offer guidance and advice, sponsors are influential leaders who actively advocate for their protégés, leveraging their position and power to create career opportunities. Hewlett argues that having a sponsor is crucial for career progression, especially for women and minorities who might face additional barriers in the workplace. The book combines research findings with real-life examples to illustrate how sponsorship can effectively drive career success.
